text:
Maya R (People Ops): Quick announcement: were piloting "Oncall Rest Days" starting May 1. Purpose: give teammates a low-friction way to recover after significant oncall work. Short summary + link below. :sun_with_face:

Diego L (Platform): Nice. What defines "significant"?

Maya R (People Ops): For the pilot: incidents with >2 hours of continuous paging or incidents escalated to P0/P1 with an incident review. We can tweak thresholds after the pilot based on feedback.

Linh T (SRE): How do folks request the day? Manager approval?

Maya R (People Ops): Submit via the HR time-off form selecting "Oncall Rest" and paste the pager/incident link. The system will auto-approve when the incident matches criteria; managers get a notification and can deny only in edge cases. Aim is to avoid manual approvals.

Kara P (Eng Manager): Limits? Dont want gaming or everyone taking a day for micro-incidents.

Maya R (People Ops): Pilot rules: max 2 rest days per quarter per person, must be used within 10 business days of the incident, and theyre additive to regular PTO. Team leads can request an exception review if a special case arises.

Diego L (Platform): Does this apply across Hosted/Dedicated/Private infra teams? Our rotations vary.

Maya R (People Ops): Yes across the company. If your team has a documented different oncall threshold, email people-ops and well add a team-specific rule for the pilot.

Linh T (SRE): Any change in headcount reporting or payroll?

Maya R (People Ops): No payroll impact  its tracked as a separate time-off category. hr-bot will confirm entries in the HR system. Well capture anonymized usage metrics for the pilot (counts by team, time-to-take).

Kara P (Eng Manager): Can we convert to remote "soft" days if someone is traveling?

Maya R (People Ops): Yes, coordinate with your manager. Auto-approval still applies but managers can work with employees to schedule equivalent rest within the window.

Diego L (Platform): Will managers see why it was auto-approved?

Maya R (People Ops): Managers see the incident link and the auto-approval flag; they dont see pager content beyond the link.

Maya R (People Ops): Pilot length: 12 weeks. Well run a short survey at the end and share summary metrics and recommendations. If youd like a one-paragraph blurb to share in team channels, DM me and Ill send copy.

Linh T (SRE): Thanks  much appreciated. Small gestures like this help retention. :pray:

hr-bot: System: "Oncall Rest" time-off type has been added to the HR portal. Form: https://redwood.internal/hr/oncall-rest (please include incident link when submitting).
